thread:
alex_chen: quick heads-up: nvlink rx_crc spikes + occasional PCIe post 43 in eu-west-2 rack12. p99 generation latency for a handful of dedicated slices jumped ~2.8x over the last 20m.
liam_sre: ouch. which slices?
alex_chen: tenantA-dedicated-11, tenantB-slice-5, warmpool-3. ran `telemetry.query("gpu.link.errors", region="eu-west-2", last=20m)` - shows NVLINK soft resets and NIC tx retries.
maria_ops: ops-bot opened INC-2026-evac. attaching inventory now. :clipboard:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-evac created. Affected: tenantA-dedicated-11, tenantB-slice-5, warmpool-3.
devon_infra: recent NIC driver 0.9.4 landed in eu-west-2 last Thursday. suspect interaction with NVLINK microcode. firmware counters show link flaps.
liam_sre: any thermal or power noise?
alex_chen: thermals normal. NVLINK counters increment on RDMA bursts. Repro: `bench-rdma --host rack12-node04 --threads 48 --burst 10s` drops packets.
sam_plat: mitigation proposal: 1) soft-quarantine affected hosts with egress shaping, 2) divert new dedicated allocations off rack12, 3) migrate active low-priority sessions to preemptible warm pool, 4) rollback NIC driver on a canary rack. Cost ~ $1.5k if we spill large tenants for 2 hours.
maria_ops: ops prefers 2h cap then reassess. legal/customer comms queued.
devon_infra: plan looks good. also add quick scheduler tweak: prefer allocation avoiding same TOR for high-egress tenants (tor-avoid=true). small allocator hotfix.
liam_sre: agree. add NVLINK CRC threshold alert to reduce blast radius. Also throttle cross-node RDMA for a short period.
nina_eng: model-fallback note: product teams need a matrix of compatible quantized model variants so we can route without breaking pinned-model expectations. I'll start a doc.
alex_chen: starting canary reroute for tenantC (small) to test. ops-bot logged change.
ops-bot: reroute applied to tenantC-canary.
liam_sre: canary telemetry: p99 back to baseline on tenantC after reroute. Good sign. Alex, begin tenantA migration to preemptible pool; cap window to 2h.
alex_chen: migration in progress, will post progress updates.
maria_ops: reminder to notify oncall and affected customers with ETA. Draft message in #customer-notify, please review.
devon_infra: next steps (post-incident): 1) validate rollback impact, 2) schedule NVLINK microcode audit, 3) add TOR-separation flag as allocator feature, 4) emergency cost playbook for warm-pool spill.
liam_sre: if rollback doesn't reduce errors, we'll eschew those GPUs from dedicated pools until fixed. Also add backpressure on RDMA rate limiter.
ina_eng: I'll coordinate model fallback compatibility with product.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-evac updated: state=mitigating, owner=devon_infra, sla-impact=partial, est-mitigation=2h.
